# Trail 2

Native Kotlin and Swift route-animation alpha. The canonical integration API is
typed Kotlin trailEffect { } and Swift TrailEffect { }, with named effect values.

- Read docs/API_GUIDE.md for implemented syntax, ownership and composition rules.
- Copy verified examples from docs/examples/Android.md or docs/examples/iOS.md.
- Source of truth: android/playground/src/main/kotlin/dev/trail/playground/examples/IntegrationExamples.kt
  and ios/TrailPlayground/IntegrationExamples.swift. They compile with the apps.
- Run python3 scripts/sync-examples.py after changing example regions; --check
  verifies that documentation and app source panels match the compiled files.
- Plugins implement public TrailLineStyle / TrailAnimation, depend on TrailCore,
  and require no registry, reflection, annotations or macros.
- Share effects; give each visible binding its own playback controller.
- Google Maps Android and Apple MapKit are the first adapters. Read docs/MAPS.md.
- TrailRoute supports complete waypoints, direct, arc, greatCircle and encodedPolyline.
- A provider implements TrailProjection and camera/layout invalidation; TrailProjectedOverlay
  shares readiness/rendering/playback behavior. Keep SDK types out of plugins and core.
- Supplied controllers own route resets on both platforms. Camera changes never replay.
- spec/fixtures/contracts.json is shared across languages; sync with scripts/sync-fixtures.py.
- Repeated declarations are invalid. Use explicit sequence or layer blocks.
- Fluent/generated APIs in docs/archive are unimplemented historical proposals.
- No Maven or remote Swift package release has been published for this alpha.
- Tests and limits: docs/VERIFICATION.md. Relaunch gates: docs/DESIGN.md.
- Legacy Java code is preserved under legacy/android; it is not the new API.
